question: The cost of 9 pens and 9 pencils is ₹252. If the cost of a pen decreases by ₹1 and the cost of a pencil increases by ₹3, then the cost of 13 pens and 3 pencils is ₹100. What is the original cost of 10 pens and 19 pencils?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

From Case 1: 9 pens + 9 pencils = 252 ⇒ 1 pen + 1 pencil = 28.

From Case 2: 13(pen − 1) + 3(pencil + 3) = 100 ⇒ 13 pens + 3 pencils = 104.

Equating both: 13(pen) + 3(28 − pen) = 104 ⇒ 10 pens = 20 ⇒ 1 pen = ₹2.

Cost of 1 pencil = 28 − 2 = ₹26.

Required cost of 10 pens and 19 pencils = 10(2) + 19(26) = 20 + 494 = ₹514.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹514.**
